objective: Proofs: the hub identity and the exact single-hub threshold (32 copies); the irreducible-set distance equals tau wherever the pair correlation is nonzero, equals bond distance minus one on parity bases, is immune to hubs, and is steps apart on pure trees and on mixed trees whose path has no parity knot; the open case stated.
status: Proved 2026-11-18 (referee pending): the hub identity and the threshold (a hub shortcuts the cumulant distance only with 32 or more copies of one spin); the irreducible-set distance delta_K (the knot test's K2 in cumulant form) equals tau wherever the pair correlates, equals bond distance minus one on parity bases, ignores hubs, and is steps apart on not-all-equal trees, parity trees and mixed trees whose path has no parity knot; the mixed case with a parity knot on the path is open (sketch).
title: Hubs and the irreducible distance: what is proved
